p: Zif: Which contains part of April and part of May.
house of the LORD: By which is meant the temple and the oracle.
porch before the temple of the: Or the court where the people prayed which was before the place where the altar of burnt offerings stood.
the oracle: When God spoke between the Cherubim, called also the most holy place.
rests round about: Which were certain stones coming out of the wall, as stays for the beams to rest upon.
house: In Exodus it is called the tabernacle, and the temple is here called the sanctuary and the oracle the most holy place.
dwell among the children of Israel: According as he promised to Moses, Ex 25:22.
the walls of the cieling: Meaning, to the roof which was also sealed.
house: For when he spoke of the house in the first verse, he meant both the oracle and the temple.
house within: That is, in the most inward place of the house.
whole altar that was by the: Meaning, the altar of incense, Ex 30:1.

overlaid the cherubims with gold: For the others which Moses made of beaten gold were taken away with the other jewels by their enemies, whom God permitted at various times to overcome them for their great sins.
spread gold upon the cherubims: So that the fashion of the carved work might still appear.
court with three rows of hewed: Where the priests were, and was thus called in respect to the great court, which is called the porch of Solomon in Ac 3:11 where the people used to pray.
Bul: Which contains part of October and part of November.
